defect.proposed_fix: Either supply cached opinion text or a corrected lake pinpoint containing the exact quoted sentence, or remove the verbatim quotation and cite the lake-supported Whiteley/Hensley rule summaries instead.

reasons: Lake Whiteley pin-568 supports the general source-basis rule, but it does not contain the quoted sentence used in the black-letter rule.

Lake Hensley pin-233 supports objective reliance on a flyer or bulletin where the issuing police possessed reasonable suspicion, but the callout's only quoted authority is not verifiable from disclosed text.
No text directory or Whiteley full opinion text is present, so character-faithful quotation review cannot be completed.
residual_risks: The unquoted doctrinal summary appears broadly supported by Whiteley pin-568 and Hensley pin-233, but the assertion as framed fails because it embeds an unverified direct quote.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add Hensley as a second direct citation in the callout for the reasonable-suspicion/flyer branch, and avoid verbatim language unless the exact opinion text or matched lake pinpoint is present.
